create_quaternion_instance: create a Quaternion with a real scalar and a 3-vector using sympy symbols
multiply_quaternions: multiply two Quaternion instances using the overloaded multiplication operator
compute_quaternion_inverse: compute the inverse of a Quaternion using the inv method and simplify the result
compute_quaternion_derivative: compute the derivative of quaternion multiplication with respect to the left or right operand
test_quaternion_operations: run the unit tests to verify quaternion multiplication and derivative computations
